summary: Orange Pharmacy Billing System - Comprehensive Testing Complete. Backend: 29/29 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 8 tabs working correctly. Login, billing search, cart, payment modes, inventory, customers, barcode, CSV, reports, purchases, and orders all functional.

issues: Console shows 404 error for suggest API when switching to inventory tab - minor, doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Backend APIs fully implemented and working:
- POST /api/pharmacy-billing/bills creates bills with stock deduction
- GET /api/pharmacy-billing/dashboard returns today's stats (revenue, bills, inventory)
- GET /api/pharmacy-billing/reports/daily-sales returns daily report with payment breakdown
- GET /api/pharmacy-billing/reports/sales-summary?days=7 returns 7-day trend
- GET /api/pharmacy-billing/reports/top-selling returns top selling items
- GET /api/pharmacy-billing/reports/stock returns stock report
- POST /api/pharmacy-billing/purchases creates purchase and auto-updates inventory
- GET /api/pharmacy-billing/medicine-search?q=para returns search results (15 items)
- POST /api/pharmacy-billing/barcode/bulk-generate generates barcodes
- GET /api/pharmacy-billing/csv-template downloads CSV template
- GET /api/pharmacy-billing/csv-export exports inventory
- Customer CRUD at /api/pharmacy-billing/customers works
Frontend components well-structured:
- BillingPOS.jsx has proper cart, payment mode selection, total calculation
- BarcodeGenerator.jsx has 65-sticker sheet format support
- CSVImport.jsx has template download, upload, export buttons
- CustomerManager.jsx has search, add, dues filter
- ReportsPanel.jsx has 4 sub-tabs (Today, 7-Day Trend, Top Selling, Stock)
- PurchaseEntry.jsx has manual entry with add row and CSV import

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 8 tabs working, billing flow functional
